foreign_title: Ein Mann geht durch die Wand
aka: A Man Goes Through the Wall‎
introduction: The Man Who Walked Through the Wall (German: Ein Mann geht durch die Wand) is a 1959 West German comedy film directed by Ladislao Vajda, starring Heinz Rühmann and Nicole Courcel. It tells the story of a man who out of frustration discovers that he has the ability to walk through walls. The film is based on the novella The Man Who Walked Through Walls by Marcel Aymé.
